thread:
sre-bot: [pager] p99 decode latency spike detected on streaming clusters (us-west-2). p99 ~ 6.1s, p95 ~ 420ms. autoscale + retries spiking. correlation with kernel rollout nvkernel-2026-03-11-c at 3351201200. paging + tail stalls mentioned in traces.

maria-ong: saw the alert. dashboards show sudden jump at 08:03 UTC, coincides with last kernel promotion. streaming endpoints for low-latency chat are the biggest hit (mainly redwood-v1-large). customers affected: ~12 orgs, mostly PLG traffic.

aj_klein: copying logs from affected pod, looks like repeated page-fault retries in decode path. short snippet: 
```
[2026-03-12T08:03:11Z] decode: trace_id=abc123 tail=6100ms model=redwood-v1-large kernel=nvkernel-2026-03-11-c
kv_cache_miss -> compilepath_eviction -> gpu_pagefault_retry -> stall
gpu_mem: 42GB used, alloc failure on retry -> fallback -> long stall
```

devon: +1 on correlation. infra-build-bot pushed kernel with new compile flags: `-O3 -DUSE_FLASHATTN=1 -DTRT_AUTO_TUNE=1`. Might be an allocator interaction under certain sequence lengths.

infra-build-bot: promotion details: kernel nvkernel-2026-03-11-c rolled to prod at 3351201200. Canary step passed perf tests (median) but tail tests were limited in CI. Build id: build-9842.

maria-ong: mitigation plan proposal: 1) flip streaming route CB to fallback model for affected routes, 2) initiate kernel rollback in affected AZs, 3) gather perf traces and memalloc histograms, 4) notify SOC/SEs for customer comms. 

anya: I can flip the circuit breaker for streaming-prod route to `redwood-v1-medium` to reduce tail exposure and preserve throughput. Doing it now.

anya: `POST /api/routes/streaming-prod/actions` payload: `{ "action": "fallback", "target_model": "redwood-v1-medium", "reason": "live tail mitigation" }` -> response 202. :white_check_mark:

aj_klein: while anya is doing CB, I'm preparing a rollback play. Recommendation: rollback kernel to nvkernel-2026-03-09-b (last known-good) for us-west-2. We'll do staged rollback AZ by AZ to avoid global disruption.

leo: starting AZ-a rollback now. Command: 
```bash
# cordon + drain and restart runtime on nodes in us-west-2a
kubectl label nodes -l zone=us-west-2a runtime-rollout=true
kubectl set image ds/runtime runtime-image=redwood/runtime:nvkernel-2026-03-09-b --namespace=infra
```

devon: also add an env var to runtime to opt-out of FlashAttention for the older kernel path, just in case: `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FLASHATTN=0`. Patch applying on rollback pods.

aj_klein: running quick A/B after AZ-a rollback — watch p99 on the canary pods.

[system]: infra: AZ-a rollback started (job id rollback-3351234567-a).

aj_klein: early numbers: on canary pods after rollback p99 dropped from ~6.1s to ~420ms within 90s. p95 unchanged. Looks like kernel change caused tail amplification.

maria-ong: great, keep rolling AZ-by-AZ. Notify accounts ops to say we identified kernel regression and rolling back; recommending reduced model for streaming until fully stable.

anya: ticket sent to accounts-team with templated note: "We observed increased tail latency on streaming endpoints, root cause is a recent kernel compile/profile change; rollback initiated; mitigations in place."

devon: root cause hypothesis: new compile flags triggered a different kernel allocator path + flashattn fused kernel that increases page-fault retries for certain KV cache miss patterns. Repro steps: long-context streaming + interleaved small requests. I'll add test harness to reproduce locally with seq lengths 2048/4096.

aj_klein: followups: collect these artifacts and upload to /mnt/incident-traces/3351234567/
- perf traces (per-gpu)
- allocator histograms
- raw decode traces
- kernel build configs

leo: handoff note for morning oncall (include timeline):
- 08:03 UTC: p99 spike detected, correlated with kernel nvkernel-2026-03-11-c
- 08:07 UTC: circuit breaker enabled -> fallback model (anya)
- 08:10 UTC: AZ-a kernel rollback started (leo)
- 08:12 UTC: canary shows p99 improvement, continue staged rollback (aj_klein)
- Customers notified by accounts (maria-ong)

maria-ong: action items for next shift: 1) finish full-region rollback, 2) run regression tests comparing nvkernel-2026-03-09-b vs -11-c with focused tail workloads, 3) confirm fixes for allocator/flashattn interaction, 4) prepare postmortem w/ root cause and mitigation.

anya: leaving runbook note in #incidents with links to rollback job, traces, and account comms. :memo:

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress, severity reduced to P2 after staged rollback shows improvement. Will remain open until full rollback and postmortem assigned.

leo: handing off to morning oncall @maria-ong, @aj_klein. If any lingering tail spikes appear, escalate to infra-build for kernel hotfix (patch allocator), and consider disabling flashattn by default for streaming workloads until fixed.

aj_klein: copy. I'll add a short-term guardrail to our deploy pipeline to require tail regression checks for kernel promotions (CI gate).

devon: creating jira INC-3351234567 and linking builds: build-9842 (bad), build-9620 (good).

maria-ong: thanks all. closing incident slack channel once full rollback completes and postmortem draft is up. :v:
